definition: ALOPEX (an abbreviation of "algorithms of pattern extraction") is a correlation based machine learning algorithm first proposed by Tzanakou and Harth in 1974.
details: ALOPEX (an abbreviation of "algorithms of pattern extraction") is a correlation based machine learning algorithm first proposed by Tzanakou and Harth in 1974.
story: Picture an architect laying out a building where every room has to know which other rooms matter to it. The layout decides what the machine can even attempt, before it learns a single thing. It is the blueprint that makes everything else possible. It is the difference between a row of isolated cubicles and one big room where everyone can hear each other. That blueprint is ALOPEX.
